title: GA validation: cross-context tests, security review, docs, accessibility, i18n

pending.reason: Hosted live validation requires a deployed hosted environment with the Langflow-owned OAuth registrations; automated evidence covers the shared code paths but the signed hosted run is a human gate.
Self-managed validation requires a customer-style deployment with customer-owned OAuth apps and a real tenant consent policy; recorded here as pending until the release owner signs the run.

Desktop validation requires the Tauri build exercising the loopback_redirect path with Langflow-owned public clients; automated tests cover the loopback configuration rules but the signed Desktop run is a human gate.

items.title: Stable schemas across supported install and upgrade paths
Least-privilege scopes: scope-missing refused before provider calls; conditional scopes gated on inputs
Secret redaction: no token material in client error payloads, API responses, logs, or credential reprs
Revocation and refresh: revoke resolves as connection-unresolved; refresh with skew; rotating-token reuse via rejected_token_digest
Policy enforcement: blocked providers and actions refused at discovery and execution
Rate-limit handling: provider 429 normalized to typed rate-limited errors; connection/OAuth endpoints rate limited
Install and upgrade on supported environments: migrations apply and roll back; GoogleOAuthToken deprecation path
Unavailable and incompatible tool behavior is explicit, tested, and fail-closed
Both callback paths (server_redirect, loopback_redirect) times both client types (confidential, public/PKCE) covered
Security review of the OAuth broker, connection API, and identity rules; every HIGH-or-higher finding closed
Documentation published: broker configuration, per-context setup, revocation, tenant-consent rollout, portability, bundle guides
Accessibility checks green in CI for every route in the a11y scan manifest; /settings/connections is unscanned and tracked by connections-ui-a11y-i18n
i18n extraction and parity checks green in CI
Live tenant/workspace consent validation per provider registration

pending.reason: Documentation review does not establish tenant consent. Each target tenant/workspace consent policy and administrator approval must be recorded against the real registration and scope set before rollout, per the matrices' tenant_consent open question.

items.title: Accessibility audit and i18n coverage of the new Connections UI (surfaces B1-B5)

pending.reason: INT-8 landed on this branch with the release-1.13.0 merge: ENABLE_INTEGRATIONS is true and /settings/connections is a registered route, so the surface is live. The route is now recorded in scripts/a11y/a11y_routes.json under gated, and src/frontend/src/__tests__/a11y-route-manifest.test.ts keeps that manifest in step with routes.tsx. It is still held out of the scanned static batch: a default-load IBM Equal Access scan reports 2 aria_id_unique violations (the view Tabs trigger aria-controls values point at TabsContent panels the page never mounts). That fix, the axe baseline (connections.a11y.spec.ts) covering surfaces B2-B5 with a seeded connection, and locale coverage still have to be added by the frontend owner.
